Against All Odds: Once per session when incapacitated by wounds: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Resilience check with [FO] up to Force rating. Heal 1 wound per [SU]; Force points add [SU].
Analyze Data: Once per session after capturing enemy data: [DI][DI] Knowledge (Warfare) check. Later that session, add [SU] equal to Knowledge (Warfare) ranks to one check about that data.
Animal Bond: Bond with one animal of silhouette up to half your Force rating (rounded down). It stays with you and follows your direction; the GM may break the bond for mistreatment.
Bodyguard: Maneuver, once per round: suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade the difficulty of combat checks against one engaged ally that many times until your next turn.
Center of Being: Maneuver, once per round with a lightsaber: until your next turn, enemy melee weapons attacking you count their critical rating as 1 higher per rank.
Codebreaker: Remove [SB] per rank from checks to break codes or decrypt communications, and lower the difficulty of those checks by one (once only).
Command: Add [BO] per rank to Leadership checks. Those you inspire add [BO] per rank to their Discipline checks for the next 24 hours.
Comprehend Technology: Once per session: Average [DI][DI] Knowledge (Education) check on one item. For the encounter, count your ranks in the skill to use or repair it as equal to your Force rating.
Crippling Blow: Raise a combat check's difficulty by one. If it deals wounds, the target suffers 1 strain each time it moves for the rest of the encounter.
Defensive Circle: Action with a lightsaber: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Lightsaber (Intellect) check. You and one ally per [SU] within short range gain ranged and melee defense until your next turn.
Defensive Stance: Maneuver, once per round: suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade the difficulty of melee attacks against you that many times until your next turn.
Defensive Training: Your wielded Lightsaber, Melee or Brawl weapon gains Defensive equal to your ranks (replaces any Defensive it already has).
Desperate Repairs: Once per session: [DI][DI][DI] Mechanics check on an engaged allied droid. It is immobilized and staggered for a round, then heals all strain and one Critical Injury of Hard severity or lower.
Disruptive Strike: Action: Lightsaber (Cunning) attack on an engaged target with [FO] up to Force rating. Spend [LS] to add [SB] to the target's next combat check this encounter.
Dodge: Incidental when targeted by a combat check: suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade the check's difficulty that many times.
Draw Closer: Action: Lightsaber (Willpower) attack on a silhouette 1 or smaller target within medium range, with [FO] up to Force rating. Spend [LS] to pull the target one range band closer or to add [SU].
Fearsome: When an adversary engages you, you may force it to make a fear check with difficulty equal to your ranks. The GM may rule some adversaries immune.
Feint: After missing with a Lightsaber, Brawl or Melee attack, spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] to upgrade the difficulty of that opponent's next attack on you by your ranks.
Field Commander: Action: Average [DI][DI] Leadership check. Allies up to your Presence may each suffer 1 strain to perform a free maneuver immediately.
Field Commander (Improved): Field Commander affects allies up to twice your Presence. Spend [TR] to let one ally perform an action instead of a maneuver.
Force Assault: After missing with a Lightsaber (Willpower) attack, spend [TR] or [AD][AD][AD] to use the Move power as a maneuver this turn (you must own Move).
Force Protection: Maneuver: suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to Force rating or your ranks. Soak rises by that amount; suffer 1 strain each turn the dice stay committed.
Forewarning: Action: allies within medium range add your Force rating to melee and ranged defense until they take their first turn this encounter.
Formation Tactics: Action: [DI][DI][DI] Leadership check. Choose allies within short range up to [SU]; attacks against them are upgraded once until the end of your next turn.
Full Throttle: Action: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Piloting check. On success the vehicle's top speed rises by 1 for a number of rounds equal to your Cunning.
Hawk Bat Swoop: Action: Lightsaber (Agility) attack on a target within short range with [FO] up to Force rating. Spend [LS] to engage the target as an incidental, or to add [AD].
Healing Trance: Commit [FO]. For every full encounter it stays committed, heal 1 wound per rank (every 12 hours outside encounters).
Healing Trance (Improved): When Healing Trance heals you, make a Resilience check against one Critical Injury's severity; success removes that injury.
Ichor Blade: Choose one Melee or Brawl weapon you own: it gains Cortosis and Pierce 2 and its Critical rating drops by 1. If it is lost, apply this to a new weapon.
Imbue Item: Maneuver: suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] to enhance an item within short range: +1 damage, a cheaper critical or quality, +1 armor defense, or −2 encumbrance. 1 strain per turn while committed.
Inside Knowledge: Once per session in an enemy facility or vessel: [DI][DI][DI] Skulduggery check to find a stashed personal item (rarity up to Cunning + 2) or gain a narrative benefit.
Inside Person: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to have been undercover at an enemy base or large vehicle. You and allies add [AD][AD] to checks tied to that location this session.
Intimidating: Suffer strain up to your ranks to downgrade the difficulty of your Coercion check that many times, or to upgrade a Coercion check made against you.
Intuitive Evasion: Maneuver while piloting a silhouette 5 or smaller vehicle: suffer 1 strain and commit [FO] up to Force rating or ranks to upgrade attacks against the vehicle. 1 strain per turn while committed.
Intuitive Improvements: When repairing or crafting a personal item, add [FO] up to Force rating. Spend [LS][LS] to give the item +1 hard point (max +2; once per item).
Makashi Finish: Action: Lightsaber (Presence) attack on an engaged target with [FO] up to Force rating. Spend [LS] to add +10 to a resulting Critical Injury roll.
Makashi Flourish: Once per encounter: Average [DI][DI] Lightsaber (Presence) check. One engaged opponent suffers strain equal to [SU] and you recover as much. [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] staggers them.
Mental Bond: Action: commit [FO] to communicate mentally with your bonded animal, sense what it senses, and direct it out to extreme range.
Now You See Me: Once per session: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Deception check. NPCs up to your Cunning within medium range forget their last thirty minutes of dealings with you.
One with the Universe: Once per session, meditate, then make an Average [DI][DI] Astrogation check. On success add [BO] to all Force power checks next encounter ([BO][BO] with a [TR]).
Parry: Incidental when hit by a Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber attack while holding a Lightsaber or Melee weapon: suffer 3 strain to reduce the damage by 2 + your ranks. Once per hit.
Parry (Improved): After you Parry a hit, spend the attacker's [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] to hit them automatically with your wielded weapon for its base damage. Check the book for the exact trigger.
Prepare to Be Boarded!: Once per encounter: opposed Coercion vs. Discipline against an enemy captain. They suffer 1 strain per [SU] and surrender the ship if that exceeds their strain threshold.
Quick Draw: Once per round on your turn, draw or holster a weapon or accessible item as an incidental instead of a maneuver.
Quick Movement: Before a non-Force check in structured play, suffer 2 strain to add [FO] up to Force rating. Spend [LS][LS] for a free Move maneuver afterwards (may be your third this turn).
Reflect: Incidental when hit by a ranged attack while holding a lightsaber: suffer 3 strain to reduce the damage by 2 + your ranks. Once per hit.
Reflect (Improved): After you Reflect a hit, spend the attacker's [DE] or [TH][TH][TH] to hit one target within medium range for the same damage. Check the book for the exact trigger.
Saber Throw: Action: Lightsaber attack as a ranged attack at a target within medium range, with [FO] up to Force rating. Must spend [LS] to hit; spend another [LS] to have the weapon return.
Sarlacc Sweep: Action: Lightsaber attack at +1 difficulty against an engaged target. Spend [AD][AD] per extra engaged target to hit it as well. Must target the hardest opponent first.
Share Pain: Incidental when your bonded animal suffers wounds: halve them (rounded up) and suffer that many wounds yourself.
Shroud: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point: you cannot be detected through the Force and your own Force powers go unnoticed for the rest of the encounter (within GM limits).
Side Step: Maneuver, once per round: suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade the difficulty of ranged attacks against you that many times until your next turn.
Slippery Minded: Action while under a Force power's effect, even one that bars actions: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Deception check to end the effect.
Strategic Form: Action with a lightsaber: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Lightsaber (Intellect) check with [FO] up to Force rating. One target per [SU] within short range can attack only you until the end of next round.
Targeted Firepower: Once per session: name a target and make a [DI][DI][DI] Knowledge (Warfare) check. Allies within short range add [AD] equal to [SU] to attacks on it this encounter.
Terrify: Action: Hard [DI][DI][DI] Coercion check with [FO] up to Force rating. One target per [SU] within medium range is disoriented until the end of next round; [LS] immobilizes one.
Unity Assault: When you miss with a combat check and roll [TR] or [AD][AD][AD], spend it to use a Force power that targets allies as a maneuver.
Valuable Facts: Once per encounter: Average [DI][DI] Knowledge check. On success add [BO] to one related check made by an ally this encounter.
Weak Foundation: Once per session: [DI][DI][DI] Knowledge (Warfare) check on a fixed structure. You and allies add [AD][AD] or [SU] to combat checks against it this encounter.
